test_type: Pre-Release Bug Fixes - Notifications, State/Status Sync, Signal History
summary: All 15 backend tests PASSED. Verified all pre-release bug fixes via code review and API testing: (1) Duplicate notification fix - signal creation only notifies on ACTIVE state, (2) Close notification on state transition, (3) State+Status field sync, (4) Signal history queries 'state: closed', (5) Dashboard aggregation uses 'state: closed', (6) Push notification payload includes priority+channelId, (7) IAP diagnostic logging. Frontend loads correctly.

test_results.dashboard_performance_stats: PASS - GET /api/dashboard returns performance stats with win_rate, total_pips, total_signals
test_results.signal_history_stats: PASS - GET /api/signals/history/stats returns closed signals with state='closed'
test_results.create_signal_notification_conditional: PASS - create_signal only sends notification when initial_state == ACTIVE
test_results.update_signal_state_close_notification: PASS - update_signal_state sends close notification when state transitions to 'closed'
test_results.update_signal_state_sets_both_fields: PASS - update_signal_state sets both 'state' AND 'status' fields
test_results.dashboard_uses_state_closed: PASS - Dashboard aggregation uses 'state: closed' (not 'status: closed')
test_results.push_notification_priority_channel: PASS - Push notification payload includes 'priority: high' and 'channelId: default'
test_results.iap_service_logs_skus: PASS - iapService.native.ts logs product SKUs and count during initialization
test_results.subscription_screen_logs_iap: PASS - subscription.tsx getStorePrice logs IAP initialization status
test_results.dashboard_timestamp_format: PASS - dashboard.tsx getDashboardAge uses same format as signals.tsx

bug_1_1_apple_duplicate_notifications.description: Signal creation fires 2x notifications on Apple
bug_1_1_apple_duplicate_notifications.fix_logic: Notification only sent when initial_state == SignalState.ACTIVE (not PENDING). Pending signals get notification when engine activates them.

bug_1_2_android_notifications_not_delive.description: Android notifications not delivered (payload missing priority/channelId)
bug_1_2_android_notifications_not_delive.fix_logic: Added 'priority: high' and 'channelId: default' to notification payload

bug_1_3_missing_notification_on_signal_c.description: No notification when signal is closed
bug_1_3_missing_notification_on_signal_c.fix_logic: When state transitions to 'closed', sends close notification via background_tasks.add_task(send_signal_close_notification...)

bug_2_dashboard_timestamp_format.description: Dashboard timestamp shows incorrect format vs other screens
bug_2_dashboard_timestamp_format.fix_logic: Uses same format as signals.tsx: 'Today at HH:MM', 'Yesterday at HH:MM', 'MMM DD at HH:MM'

bug_3_2_ios_subscription_prices_not_load.description: iOS subscription prices not loading (add diagnostic logging)
bug_3_2_ios_subscription_prices_not_load.fix_logic: Added console.log for product SKUs, count, and getStorePrice diagnostics

bug_4_manually_closed_trades_not_in_hist.description: Manually closed trades not appearing in signal history
bug_4_manually_closed_trades_not_in_hist.fix_logic: Changed query from 'status: closed' to 'state: closed' to catch manually closed trades

state_status_sync_fix.description: update_signal_state and full_update_signal now sync both state and status fields
state_status_sync_fix.fix_logic: Both endpoints now set 'status' via get_status_from_state() when state changes

frontend_test.notes: Frontend loads correctly, login page displayed

critical_code_review_comments: All notification-related fixes are correctly implemented
Duplicate notification fix: create_signal only notifies on ACTIVE state, preventing double notifications when engine activates pending signals
Close notification fix: update_signal_state sends close notification when state transitions to 'closed'
State/Status sync: Both update_signal_state and full_update_signal now set 'status' via get_status_from_state()
Signal history and dashboard now query 'state: closed' instead of 'status: closed' to catch manually closed trades
Push notification payload includes 'priority: high' and 'channelId: default' for Android delivery
IAP diagnostic logging added to iapService.native.ts and subscription.tsx for iOS price loading issues
Dashboard timestamp format matches signals.tsx format (Today/Yesterday at HH:MM)
test_credentials: N/A - no auth required for these tests
seed_data_creation: None - tests use code review and existing API endpoints
